runtime.api_probe: Constructors and splitter API were checked locally without estimator fitting; see split_diagnostics.json.

execution_limits.failure_policy: Fail closed and preserve logs on convergence warning, timeout, non-finite coefficients, or invalid probability. No retry with altered settings.
execution_limits.enforcement_note: Locked cap for the single parent-authorized run; stop on any violation and do not retry with altered settings.

study.objective: At day 28, predict recorded withdrawal during days 29-56 among the declared risk set.
study.population_definition: New-to-training: remove 2014J students appearing anywhere in 2013J before restricting either cohort to shared modules and eligible records. This does not mean first-ever student.
target_unknown_state_space: eligible with y=0: withdrawal after day 56
study.unknown_state_independence: Candidate explicit Cartesian-product assumption: each of the 58 records independently takes one of its three feasible states. No externally known total or cross-record constraint is imposed. Review and confirm before lock.
study.target_unknown_probability_requirement: Both fixed predictors must produce valid probabilities for every one of the 58 uncertain records. If any are unavailable or invalid, stop the model-specific analysis; do not use a fallback probability.

split.purpose: One 80/20 source fit/calibration split; no alternate-fold selection.
stop_conditions: Both classes must be present in source fit and calibration partitions.
Calibration partition must contain at least 20 positive records.
No student may occur in both partitions.

predictors.name: source_prevalence_constant
predictors.role: descriptive reference only; not part of the primary calibrated paired comparison

feature_definitions.signed_registration_lead_time_days: -date_registration; positive means registration before module day 0, negative means after day 0.
feature_definitions.module_one_hot: Fit category vocabulary on source-fit module values only; error on unseen category; do not learn from 2014J.
feature_definitions.activity_window: VLE days 0 through 28 inclusive only. Ignore all negative-day and day-29-or-later events.
feature_definitions.click_bins: Sum sum_click over [0,6], [7,13], [14,20], [21,27], and [28]; apply log1p to each bin total.
feature_definitions.total_clicks: Sum sum_click over days 0-28 inclusive; apply log1p.
feature_definitions.active_days: Number of distinct days with recorded VLE activity in 0-28.
feature_definitions.recency: 28 minus the most recent active day for students with activity; set to 0 for no activity and include a separate no-activity indicator.
feature_definitions.zero_activity: Preserve eligible rows with no VLE rows using a left aggregation; total clicks and active days are zero, no-activity is one.
feature_definitions.scaling: StandardScaler for numeric inputs, fit on source-fit rows only. One-hot categories are not scaled.

calibration.method: Platt sigmoid on the frozen predictor decision_function score.
calibration.parameterization: sigmoid(a * decision_score + b), fit as one-feature unpenalized binary logistic regression with intercept
calibration.calibrator_instances: Use one separate sigmoid calibrator for each frozen base predictor, both fit on the identical source calibration partition.
calibration.base_models: Fit each base model once on source-fit data. Freeze it before scoring calibration and target rows; do not refit after calibration.
calibration.eligibility: Require both classes and at least 20 positives in calibration. If unmet, stop; do not change fold or calibration method.

primary_estimand.sign: Brier(registration calibrated) - Brier(activity calibrated); positive favors activity.
primary_estimand.population: all eligible 2014J target records after declared student overlap and common-module rules, including the 58 uncertain records under partial identification
primary_estimand.identification: Finite-cohort bounds only, for the fixed frozen model probabilities. For each uncertain record, feasible states are ineligible, eligible y=0, eligible y=1. Evaluate m=0..58 included records; exact sorted-prefix paired-contribution bounds as specified in partial_brier_bounds.md.
not_covered: constraints linking uncertain states across records
primary_estimand.confidence_region: No nominal bootstrap confidence region for nonsmooth bound endpoints in this draft.

secondary_diagnostics.population: Known-label complete-case 2014J records only; explicitly conditional on observed labels and selected known-eligible cases.
secondary_diagnostics.raw_probabilities: Report as predefined secondary diagnostics, not as a way to choose calibration or models.
secondary_diagnostics.module_results: Descriptive only; no module-specific superiority claims.
secondary_diagnostics.threshold_metrics: None prespecified; no threshold selection in this draft.

prohibitions: No model fitting, calibration fitting, prediction experiment, tuning, or target inspection before a reviewed protocol lock and explicit later authorization.
Never fit preprocessing, categories, normalizers, calibration, thresholds, or vocabulary on 2014J.
Do not change cohorts, modules, target horizon, population, uncertain-case count, or feature definitions to improve results.
Do not impute dates, infer withdrawal from VLE activity, or silently drop uncertain target records from the primary estimand.
Do not claim causal benefit, deployment benefit, publication readiness, novelty, or a new algorithm.
unresolved_before_lock: Independent mathematical review of the feasible three-state set and its record-level independence assumption.
Confirm all 58 target uncertain records have day-28 features and valid scores under each frozen model; otherwise stop, with no fallback.
Review source-cohort quarantine and source-selection implications; the proposed fit uses the 7676 accepted source records only.
Review whether 10 fixed reliability bins are adequately populated and whether a descriptive calibration table is preferable to a scalar metric.
Review exact sklearn version pin and execution resource bound before any later fit.
